title: How emotion vectors line up with the guardrail direction
question: What is the cosine between each emotion vector and the refusal direction, and is it above chance?
headline: At layer 11, hostile points most towards the guardrail direction (cos +0.08) and happy most away (-0.10); random directions stay within plus or minus 0.039.
